intro.text: Two rules govern this section. An ECG is obtained within 10 minutes of arrival for every adult with chest pain, epigastric pain, unexplained breathlessness, syncope, or sweating — including diabetics and the elderly with vague symptoms. And breathlessness is a syndrome, not a diagnosis: the reflex combination of a bronchodilator, a steroid and a diuretic given to every dyspnoeic patient will harm as many as it helps.

, which reduces mortality.
